definition: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., doing business as DeepSeek, is a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company that develops open weights large language models (LLMs).
details: Based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, DeepSeek is owned and funded by High-Flyer, a Chinese hedge fund.

explainer.lead: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI company based in Hangzhou that develops large language models with open weights. It is backed by High-Flyer, a Chinese hedge fund, and its name refers to the company rather than to one specific algorithm or model.

tiers.eli5: DeepSeek is a workshop in Hangzhou, China, where people build computer programs that can work with language. Think of a language model as a very complicated recipe learned from examples: DeepSeek makes the learned settings available instead of keeping them all locked away. The workshop is owned and paid for by a Chinese investment company called High-Flyer.
tiers.practitioner: Treat DeepSeek as the developer, not as one uniquely specified model. When open weights are a project requirement, its LLMs are candidates for evaluation; deployment tooling, hardware needs, and task performance must be checked for the particular model being used.
tiers.paperLevel: DeepSeek denotes Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., an organization based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, that develops open-weights LLMs. Ownership and funding come from High-Flyer, a Chinese hedge fund; the term itself specifies neither an architecture, training method, nor performance bound.

explainer.example: A team building a document-summary prototype requires open model weights. It identifies DeepSeek as a company developing such LLMs, then selects and tests a specific model release rather than treating the company name as a model version.
